content.title: Family stewardship
content.summary: Baba Muyi’s life demonstrates that family history must be preserved with context, care, and responsibility.
content.body: Historical connection: As the father of twenty-seven children and the head of a large extended household, Baba Muyi carried responsibilities that reached across generations. His life shows that preserving family history requires more than remembering names; it requires gathering evidence, recording different perspectives, protecting sensitive information, and passing history forward honestly. Practical lesson: Each generation has a responsibility to preserve what it knows before important memories, documents, and witnesses are lost. Related chapter: Family, Responsibility and Sacrifice.
